prompt_text: Where should I buy tires in Pleasanton CA and who does the best installation?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — do you want general buying/install advice or a short list of specific shops in Pleasanton with ratings and contact info? If you want specific places, tell me your ZIP (or say “Pleasanton, CA”) and I’ll pull nearby options.

Short guidance now so you can decide:

Where to buy
- Big warehouse/club stores (Costco if you’re a member, sometimes Sam’s Club): excellent prices on many popular tires and usually include mounting, lifetime rotations, and road‑hazard protection with good customer service.
- National tire retailers (Discount Tire, Firestone Complete Auto Care, Pep Boys): large selection, frequent promotions, fast scheduling, and reliable installs.
- Local independent tire shops/dealers: often the best customer service, willingness to work with specialty tires, and more personal follow‑up. Good for performance/oversized tires or if you want a local relationship.
- Your vehicle dealer: best for OE replacements and work on newer cars with complex TPMS/drive systems (but usually more expensive).

Who does the best installation (what to look for)
- Reputation and reviews: look at recent Google and Yelp reviews for installation and balancing quality.
- Equipment: ask whether they use a road‑force balancer (useful for tires that vibrate) and modern mounting machines for low‑profile or run‑flat tires.
- Services included: mounting, wheel weights, valve stems/TPMS service, lug nut torque, disposal, alignment check/offer, lifetime rotation/balancing, and road‑hazard warranty.
- Warranty & price transparency: confirm labor warranty and whether alignment is included or offered at a discount.
- Technician experience: dealerships and specialized tire shops often have technicians trained on TPMS, run‑flats, and high‑performance wheels.
- Turnaround and scheduling: Discount Tire and Costco often have fast service; independents may offer more personalized service and follow‑ups.

If you want, I can:
- Find 4–6 top-rated tire shops/installers near Pleasanton and compare services, hours, and common prices.
- Give a checklist of questions to ask when calling for a quote.
Which would you prefer?
